integrity: The first two moments and sharp variance-majorization classification are proved symbolically; finite rational checks supplement rather than replace the proof. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
limitations: Strictly positive arm lengths and normalized arclength sampling on a one-hub tree. No variance extrema or arbitrary-tree extension are asserted. Dahl (2007) full article and some classical pre-2000 texts were inaccessible; priority remains best of examined sources.
title: A sharp four-arm variance-majorization threshold for weighted metric stars
